name: The Platinum Discs
summary: Sage Truthseeker studies the Platinum Discs and sends you to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff with a reward voucher. He believes the find may lead to more work together.

sections.title: A Voucher for Bena
sections.body: Sage Truthseeker turns his attention to the Platinum Discs, hoping to learn how they work. For now, he sends you to Bena Winterhoof, Thunder Bluff's alchemy trainer, with a voucher. She is to give you a special item and let you choose potions from his stock.

faq.q: What does Sage Truthseeker want me to do?
faq.answer: Take Sage Truthseeker's reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof, the alchemy trainer in Thunder Bluff.
Bena Winterhoof is the alchemy trainer in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What is Sage doing with the discs?
faq.answer: Sage Truthseeker is focusing his energies on the Platinum Discs to learn how they work.

faq.q: What can I choose from Sage's potions?
faq.answer: You may choose five superior healing potions or five greater mana potions.

faq.q: Is there more to do with Sage?
faq.answer: Sage senses there is more to do with you regarding the find.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Platinum Discs
